documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Intimation To The Holders Of Physical Shares To Furnish KYC Details

analysis.summary: Ador Welding Limited reported a strong start to FY27, with Q1 revenue growing 23% YoY to Rs. 309 crore, driven by healthy order inflows and momentum across domestic and export markets. The company is executing an ongoing Rs. 80 crore modernization and expansion capex program, which is being funded through internal accruals without additional leverage. Operating margins are expected to remain stable, supported by an improving product mix, cost discipline, and higher capacity utilization.

guidance.claim: Operating margins are expected to remain at similar levels, supported by an improving product mix, cost discipline, and higher capacity utilization.
guidance.quote: Operating margins are expected to remain at similar levels, supported by an improving product mix, cost discipline, and higher capacity utilization.

guidance.claim: The company expects continued distributor expansion in the Middle East to support further growth.
guidance.quote: The Middle East remains the primary export market, with continued distributor expansion expected to support further growth.

guidance.claim: The company expects to see EBITDA margin improvements over the next few quarters.
guidance.quote: We are working towards it and whatever little we can do as fast as possible, we will do it. But surely over the next few quarters, you will see EBITDA margin improvements happening.

guidance.claim: Management believes the company can improve its margins by another 100 to 200 basis points over the coming periods.
guidance.quote: So I think on a similar trajectory, you can see that happen, for another 100, 200 basis points going forward over the coming periods.

guidance.claim: The company aims to perform better than the IIP and GDP growth rates of 6% to 8%.
guidance.quote: As of now, we remain -- if you take IIP numbers, GDP numbers, 6%, 7%, 8% in that region and you hope that those numbers consistently perform. I think we are in a position to do better than that.

guidance.claim: The company expects the process equipment flare business to achieve a product line size of approximately INR 20 crores.
guidance.quote: I think we should be all right for the process equipment flare from approximately a INR20 crores kind of number that I am talking to you about.

demand_outlook.claim: The company experienced a strong start to FY27 with Q1 revenue growing 23% YoY, reflecting healthy order inflow and strong momentum across domestic and export markets.
demand_outlook.quote: FY27 has begun strongly for Ador, with Q1 revenue growing 23% YoY to Rs. 309 Cr - reflecting healthy order inflow and strong momentum from FY26 across domestic and export markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Rising labour costs are increasing the demand for productivity and efficiency, making automation a strategic priority.
demand_outlook.quote: Automation remains a strategic priority as rising labour costs increase demand for productivity and efficiency.

demand_outlook.claim: Certain product lines are outperforming market growth, while others have been quieter in recent months.
demand_outlook.quote: We are seeing certain product lines outperforming on market growth. We are seeing some product lines have a little bit quieter last four or five months especially, but we are seeing it pretty much in line with steel consumption as well as in line with the figures that we are showing over here.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects exports to perform better in their operating markets based on the current order book and inquiry base.
demand_outlook.quote: So far this year, what we have seen is the order book, inquiry base, and approvals where we are set up, exports should do better -- should do well, should do better for the markets we operate in.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand has been healthy in the Saudi Arabian market from December onwards compared to calendar year 2025.
demand_outlook.quote: In the last three-four months, it has been a little healthier than what we saw, I would say from December onwards it has been a little healthier than what we saw during calendar year '25. Definitely.

demand_outlook.claim: Despite macroeconomic circumstances, overall demand is not bad.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand is all right, it is not bad. Given all the macroeconomic circumstances, in fact, I would imagine it could have been worse, it is not.

capex_expansion.claim: Ador is evaluating acquisition opportunities to strengthen expertise and accelerate growth in the robotics and automation segment.
capex_expansion.quote: Ador continues to build internal capabilities in robotics and automation while evaluating acquisition opportunities to strengthen expertise and accelerate growth in this segment.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's capex is generally expected to be around INR 30 crores to INR 35 crores for the coming year.
capex_expansion.quote: Our capex is generally in the region of approximately INR30 crores-INR35 crores for the coming year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expects to add two to three new lines and spend up to INR 40 crores on capex each year over the next two years.
capex_expansion.quote: And this year we will have two-three lines that are coming that are new that are for this year and next year. So we expect INR30 crores- INR35 crores, even it could stretch it out to INR40 maybe at the most over the next two years, each year.

capex_expansion.claim: The planned capex is entirely for the welding segment, primarily focusing on consumables.
capex_expansion.quote: No, no, no, no. This is all welding. This is all welding and primarily on the consumables, not on equipment.

capex_expansion.claim: Doubling volume in five to seven years would require approximately INR 100 crores to INR 150 crores of capex for plant, machinery, and capability.
capex_expansion.quote: I would say in the region of approximately INR120. I am not talking about anything to do with land and all of that, I am just talking in terms of plant, machinery, capability and stuff. I will say anywhere in the region of INR100 crores to INR150 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Operating margins are expected to remain at similar levels, supported by an improving product mix, cost discipline, and higher capacity utilization.
margins_costs.quote: Operating margins are expected to remain at similar levels, supported by an improving product mix, cost discipline, and higher capacity utilization.

margins_costs.claim: Standalone revenue grew by 2%, gross margins reached 38%, and the EBITDA margin was 12% for the year.
margins_costs.quote: For the year standalone, revenue is up about 2%, gross margins at 38%, up about 250 bps. The EBITDA margin at 12%.

margins_costs.claim: In Quarter 4, revenue growth was approximately 3%, EBITDA increased by 200 basis points to INR 38 crores, and gross margin was approximately 36%.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue growth was approximately 3% for the year -- for Quarter 4, sorry and EBITDA clocked in at approximately INR38 crores, an increase of 200 bps. Gross margin was approximately 36% and the PBT was at approximately INR39 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Customers are showing caution due to ongoing inflationary impacts.
margins_costs.quote: It is just that you have inflationary impacts that you are dealing with at the moment, so you will see customers be a little bit cautious in that regard.

margins_costs.claim: The company presented its FY26 standalone metrics excluding onerous costs, LD charges, Kuwait project recovery, and exceptional items.
margins_costs.quote: *Excluding onerous cost, LD charges, Kuwait project recovery and exceptional items

orders_capacity.claim: The welding division operates at a capacity utilization of approximately 70%.
orders_capacity.quote: We are anywhere -- welding has a lot of different types of lines in consumables as well as in equipment, but I would say a fair estimate is anywhere in the region of approximately 70%.

orders_capacity.claim: Some of the company's lines operate at 90% to 95% capacity, requiring capex and investment in new technologies.
orders_capacity.quote: There are some lines that currently operate at 90%-95% for which we need to undertake capex, some new technologies we need to invest for as well, but yes, pretty much along that.

orders_capacity.claim: The company does not have long order book periods because 80% to 85% of sales operate on a distribution system.
orders_capacity.quote: We actually, you know, our business operates on a -- 80% to 85% of our sales is on a distribution system. We distribute across the country for our welding business, our maintenance and repair business, as well as in our international we work through distribution. So we don't have long order book periods.

orders_capacity.claim: The company is experiencing its best-ever order book for welding automation.
orders_capacity.quote: Seeing that benefit coming, we are seeing our best order book for us on the welding automation than we have ever seen.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is open to targeted acquisitions that are more dependent on technology than market share.
capital_allocation.quote: We are open to acquisitions, but our acquisitions are a little more targeted now.

capital_allocation.claim: The company recovered INR 14 crores from its old Kuwait project.
capital_allocation.quote: The Kuwait project recovery, which was a lot of good work done by the team for the recovery that was pending from 2020-2021, that finally led to INR14 crores of recovery, and PBT of approximately INR130 crores excluding the onerous cost of the Uran project.

risks_headwinds.claim: Rising labour costs are increasing the demand for productivity and efficiency.
risks_headwinds.quote: Automation remains a strategic priority as rising labour costs increase demand for productivity and efficiency.

risks_headwinds.claim: Supply chain shocks are causing a lack of clarity for planning purposes.
risks_headwinds.quote: But supply chain shocks are just the way things are at the moment, you know, lack of clarity for many planning purposes.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company's BIS hearings have closed, but the process is still going on in magistrate court.
risks_headwinds.quote: So the BIS hearings, most of it is closed, but it still got to go back to magistrate court, which we have been given a date sometime in June-July.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company has filed an appeal against an income tax matter and is hopeful of a favorable outcome.
risks_headwinds.quote: So income tax matter, we have filed our appeal last week only and we don't see any merit, means that the department will succeed in that.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company's forward-looking statements are subject to risks and uncertainties that could cause actual results to differ from expectations.
risks_headwinds.quote: All such statements, estimates & projections reflect various assumptions by management concerning possible anticipated results and are subject to risk & uncertainties, which may cause the Company’s actual future results to differ from those expected by the Investors.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company incurred onerous costs and LD charges which were excluded from its operational EBITDA calculations.
risks_headwinds.quote: *Excluding onerous cost & LD charges, excluding recovery from Kuwait project and exceptional items.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects capex to be around INR 30 crores to INR 35 crores for the coming year.
management_commitments.quote: Our capex is generally in the region of approximately INR30 crores-INR35 crores for the coming year.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to add two to three new lines and spend up to INR 40 crores on capex each year over the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: And this year we will have two-three lines that are coming that are new that are for this year and next year. So we expect INR30 crores- INR35 crores, even it could stretch it out to INR40 maybe at the most over the next two years, each year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
